# Trustpilot
> Consumer review platform where people read, write, and share reviews about businesses and services worldwide.

Trustpilot helps consumers make informed choices through public reviews and helps businesses collect feedback, manage reputation, and improve customer trust.

## Core Platform
- [Home](https://www.trustpilot.com/): Main entry point for discovering companies, categories, and recent reviews.
- [Categories](https://www.trustpilot.com/categories): Browse businesses and services by industry and review category.
- [Review a Company](https://www.trustpilot.com/review): Search for a business and write a customer review.
- [Log In](https://www.trustpilot.com/users/connect): Sign in to manage reviews, profile, and account settings.
- [My Reviews](https://www.trustpilot.com/users/myreviews): View and manage reviews written from your Trustpilot account.
- [Trustpilot Community](https://www.trustpilot.com/community): Community area covering reviewer participation and platform engagement.

## For Consumers
- [How Trustpilot Works](https://www.trustpilot.com/about): Overview of the review platform, reviewer experience, and trust model.
- [Consumer Help Center](https://support.trustpilot.com/hc/en-us/categories/360000632353-Consumers): Help articles for writing, editing, and reporting reviews.
- [Your User Account](https://support.trustpilot.com/hc/en-us/sections/360003930534-Your-user-account): Guidance on profile settings, login, and account management.
- [Writing Reviews](https://support.trustpilot.com/hc/en-us/sections/360003930554-Writing-reviews): Help for creating, updating, and publishing reviews.
- [Reporting Reviews](https://support.trustpilot.com/hc/en-us/sections/360003930574-Reporting-reviews): Information on flagging reviews and handling content concerns.
- [Trust and Transparency](https://www.trustpilot.com/trust): Policies and principles behind review integrity and platform trust.

## For Businesses
- [Business](https://business.trustpilot.com/): Main business platform for collecting reviews and managing reputation.
- [Business Login](https://business.trustpilot.com/users/connect): Sign in to access Trustpilot Business tools and settings.
- [Plans and Pricing](https://business.trustpilot.com/pricing): Overview of business subscription plans and feature tiers.
- [Review Collection](https://business.trustpilot.com/features/review-collection): Tools for inviting customers and collecting service reviews.
- [Review Management](https://business.trustpilot.com/features/review-management): Features for responding to reviews and monitoring feedback.
- [Showcase Trustpilot](https://business.trustpilot.com/features/showcase-trustpilot): Widgets and assets for displaying Trustpilot content on owned channels.

## Business Help Center
- [Business Help Center](https://support.trustpilot.com/hc/en-us/categories/360000632393-Business): Support hub for Trustpilot Business users and administrators.
- [Getting Started](https://support.trustpilot.com/hc/en-us/sections/360003928733-Getting-started): Setup guidance for new business accounts and core configuration.
- [Inviting Customers](https://support.trustpilot.com/hc/en-us/sections/360003928753-Inviting-customers): Instructions for sending review invitations and automating collection.
- [Managing Reviews](https://support.trustpilot.com/hc/en-us/sections/360003928773-Managing-reviews): Help for replying to, flagging, and analyzing reviews.
- [Account and Users](https://support.trustpilot.com/hc/en-us/sections/360003928793-Account-and-users): Manage permissions, business settings, and team access.
- [TrustBox and Website Integration](https://support.trustpilot.com/hc/en-us/sections/360003928813-TrustBox-and-website-integration): Documentation for embedding Trustpilot widgets and integrations.

## Developers and Integrations
- [Developers](https://developers.trustpilot.com/): Developer portal for APIs, authentication, and integration resources.
- [API Documentation](https://developers.trustpilot.com/documentation): Reference documentation for Trustpilot developer APIs.
- [Getting Started](https://developers.trustpilot.com/getting-started): Introductory guide for building with Trustpilot APIs.
- [Authentication](https://developers.trustpilot.com/authentication): Details on authorization and access requirements for API usage.
- [Business Units API](https://developers.trustpilot.com/business-units-api): API reference for business profile and review summary data.
- [Product Reviews API](https://developers.trustpilot.com/product-reviews-api): API reference for working with product review content.
- [Invitations API](https://developers.trustpilot.com/invitations-api): API documentation for creating and managing review invitations.

## Trust, Legal, and Policies
- [Trust Center](https://www.trustpilot.com/trust): Central hub for trust principles, moderation, and transparency information.
- [Guidelines for Reviewers](https://legal.trustpilot.com/for-reviewers/guidelines-for-reviewers): Rules and expectations for writing reviews on Trustpilot.
- [Guidelines for Businesses](https://legal.trustpilot.com/for-businesses/guidelines-for-businesses): Standards for businesses using Trustpilot and engaging with reviews.
- [Terms and Conditions](https://legal.trustpilot.com/for-reviewers/end-user-privacy-terms): Legal terms and privacy information for platform users.
- [Privacy Policy](https://legal.trustpilot.com/for-reviewers/end-user-privacy-terms): Privacy and data handling terms for reviewers and users.
- [Cookie Policy](https://legal.trustpilot.com/for-reviewers/cookie-policy): Information about cookies and tracking technologies on Trustpilot.
- [Whistleblower Policy](https://legal.trustpilot.com/for-everyone/whistleblower-policy): Policy for reporting serious concerns related to Trustpilot operations.
